answer: VDF Timing at the vertex: each identity must solve a sequential delay puzzle at epoch start. The marble of elapsed wall-clock time cannot be forged or parallelized — hardware speedups give linear, not multiplicative, advantage. A garden of sybils pays full sequential cost per identity, so n identities cost n×T compute. Verifiable proofs make cheating detectable. Sybils die because time is the one resource no attacker can buy in bulk.
